commands.description: List of command usage patterns for fstrcmp with specific modes and arguments. Each entry describes a scenario where fstrcmp is invoked with a particular option group and argument list. Mode must be one of 'pair', 'wide-pair', 'files-as-bytes', or 'select'. For 'select' mode, args must contain at least two strings: the needle followed by one or more hayaws (alternatives). The default pattern provides a minimal 'pair' usage (compare two strings).
